tools.description: Start a session in the machine store and return it ({ session: { id, actor, startedAt, endedAt, meta, runs? } }). Export the id as FACET_SESSION for the runs that follow.

meta.description: Pointers only (harness ids, cwd); merged over Herdr ids. Never transcripts or secrets.

tools.name: session_start

tools.description: End a session (default: FACET_SESSION). Idempotent: alreadyEnded says whether it was already closed.
tools.name: session_end

tools.description: Probe's request list for a collection: { requests: [ { selector, name, method, url, … } ] }. Use selectors, never names.

path.description: Collection path: an OpenCollection YAML file or an unbundled workspace directory

tools.name: request_list

tools.description: Probe's request get: one request as stored, or resolved with an environment.

path.description: Collection path: an OpenCollection YAML file or an unbundled workspace directory

tools.name: request_get

tools.description: Execute a request through Facet and record it in Lattice. Result is Probe's request-run document plus lattice { runId, requestHash, secrets, … }. With dryRun the request is resolved and previewed, nothing sent or recorded. TypeSafe/Jev: hydrate typesafeApiKey via facet env set --secret (TYPESAFE_API_KEY), never Lattice; jevShadow empty/ask/escalate/hold ≠ approve.

dryRun.description: Preview only: resolve, redact, do not send

environment.description: Environment name; enables secret hydration from the machine store

expect.description: Assert the status after a real run: "2xx", "200,201", or an array like [200, "3xx"]. Miss → exit 1 expect_failed with the full document.

path.description: Collection path: an OpenCollection YAML file or an unbundled workspace directory

tag.description: Tags to store with the run

var.description: Variable overrides (--var). Never a secret: names stored in the Facet machine store are refused; hydration supplies them.

tools.name: request_run

tools.description: Recorded runs, newest first, metadata only (bodies are explicit pulls). Filters AND together.

environment.description: Only runs resolved with this environment

hash.description: Request hash, request body hash, or response body hash; rows say matchedHash

path.description: File or directory inside the workspace (default: current directory); Facet walks up to .facet/lattice.db

since.description: Only runs started at or after this Unix millisecond time

status.description: Only runs with this HTTP status

tag.description: Every listed tag must be present

tools.name: history_list

tools.description: One recorded run by id: { workspace, run }. run_not_found (exit 4) when unknown.

path.description: File or directory inside the workspace (default: current directory); Facet walks up to .facet/lattice.db

tools.name: history_get

tools.description: One stored body by SHA-256: { blob: { hash, sizeBytes, contentType, body } }. Bodies may contain secrets the redaction list cannot see.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex from a history row

path.description: File or directory inside the workspace (default: current directory); Facet walks up to .facet/lattice.db

tools.name: blob_get

tools.description: Hash-first comparison of two recorded runs: changes by field, request.hash, both bodies. durationMs, actor, and tags never flip equal.

bodies.description: Unified diff for differing inline UTF-8 response bodies

path.description: File or directory inside the workspace (default: current directory); Facet walks up to .facet/lattice.db

tools.name: run_diff

tools.description: Re-send a recorded run from the current YAML at the recorded environment; the new run carries replayedFrom. frozen refuses when the request hash changed (exit 1 replay_changed).

expect.description: Assert the status after a real run: "2xx", "200,201", or an array like [200, "3xx"]. Miss → exit 1 expect_failed with the full document.

frozen.description: Refuse when the resolved request differs from the recorded hash

tag.description: Extra tags (the recorded ones carry over)

var.description: Variable overrides (--var). Never a secret: names stored in the Facet machine store are refused; hydration supplies them.

tools.name: run_replay

tools.description: Parse, typecheck and evaluate a Nickel world module in-process. Returns { path, moduleHash, contractSet }. Nothing persisted.

var.description: Nickel field overrides (path.to.field → expression). Never a secret value or secret field path.

tools.name: ncl_check

tools.description: eval_full_for_export on a Nickel world module. Returns { path, moduleHash, exportHash, contractSet, cluster, intent, calls }. Fields marked | not_exported are absent.

var.description: Nickel field overrides (path.to.field → expression). Never a secret value or secret field path.

tools.name: ncl_export

tools.description: Export a Nickel world module, POST frozen cluster JSON when FACET_KUBECONFIG is set, put intent rows through Hedron Store when FACET_HEDRON_DB is set, and record one ncl:apply Lattice row. Returns export fields plus action summary.

var.description: Nickel field overrides (path.to.field → expression). Never a secret value or secret field path.

tools.name: ncl_apply

tools.description: Read-only SQL over the workspace store (runs, blobs). Body, header, and environment secret columns are NULL. Writes fail with sql_read_only. The machine store is never attached.

path.description: File or directory inside the workspace (default: current directory); Facet walks up to .facet/lattice.db

tools.name: sql_query
